data_scope: Previously seen development/evaluation material only; not a protected holdout.
selection_hash: SHA-256 of UTF-8 `seed:stratum:id`; sort ascending within stratum.

stratum_definition.old_changed: Old audio arm has at least one applied entity_audio_repair change.
stratum_definition.old_replayed_no_change: Not a control; old repair checks>0 and applied changes=0.
stratum_definition.no_replay_or_negative: No old replay, or cohort is negative/no_registered_target. Actual changed rows take precedence.

reference_policy: References/gold were not read for selection and are not copied into this plan; they remain scoring-only inputs outside the inference set.
inference_fields_note: Records contain metadata, library key, PCM path/hash, old replay/change flags and split. No reference sentence, transcript, gold entity, or text-derived sample feature is included.
